```{r Erica's species key}
# Erica_SpKey <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/general/Species_Keys/Erica_CONAPESCA_SpKey_Nov052025.csv")
# # 600 obs of 17 variables

Erica_SpKey <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/EMF_CONAPESCA_Exploration/CONAPESCA_SpeciesNames_OctNov2025/AllGoC_SpKey_Oct312025.csv")
# 1246 obs of 8 variables

Hem_SpKey <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/general/Species_Keys/Hem_CONAPESCA_SpKey_2018.csv")
# 8232 obs of 3 variables

Mar_SpKey <- read_csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/general/Species_Keys/Mar_CONAPESCA_SpKey.csv")
# 443 obs of 30 variables
```

```{r Prepare to merge}
Erica_SpKey <- Erica_SpKey %>%
  mutate(recorded_species_name_clean = tolower(recorded_species_name_clean))

Mar_SpKey <- Mar_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))
Mar_SpKey_filtered <- Mar_SpKey %>% select(fishery, common_name_IHH= common_name, highest_taxonomic_id, highest_taxonomic_resolution, species, genus, family, order, class, IHH_functional_major_groups_sm)

Hem_SpKey <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  mutate(common_name = tolower(common_name))

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  select(common_name, species)

Hem_SpKey_filtered <- Hem_SpKey %>%
  select(common_name, species)
```

```{r Merge}
merged_df1 <- stringdist_join(
  Erica_SpKey,
  Mar_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_species_name_clean" = "common_name_IHH"),
  method = "jw",          # Jaro-Winkler works well for name matching
  max_dist = 0.15,        # adjust as needed
  distance_col = "dist"   # keep the distance so you can inspect match quality
)

merged_df1 <- merged_df1 %>% distinct()

merged_df2 <- stringdist_join(
  merged_df1,
  Hem_SpKey_filtered,
  by = c("recorded_species_name_clean" = "common_name"),
  method = "jw",          # Jaro-Winkler works well for name matching
  max_dist = 0.15,        # adjust as needed
  distance_col2 = "dist"   # keep the distance so you can inspect match quality
)

```
